name: Hokuto Megumi
source: A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the earth type guardian Genbu. A cold blooded and calculating woman. Is especially fond of her subordinate and long time friend Jin. [spoiler]After Jin's betrayal she loses her calm personality as she becomes obsessed with getting revenge.[/spoiler]
translation: A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the earth type guardian Genbu. A cold blooded and calculating woman. Is especially fond of her subordinate and long time friend Jin.
